candidate_lineage: v8 C++ search fork with ownership-aware TELE travel, broader guard and new terminal planner; not Python delineate-v1

randomness.default: random_device seeds mt19937 once on first TURN
randomness.active_use: One discrete_distribution draw for each late non-LOCK offensive F target
limits: Time-budgeted early search can still choose differently under different runtime/load.
The submitted no-argument program uses a fresh entropy seed; fixed-seed comparisons are one policy-seed condition.
Cross-standard-library discrete_distribution results are not guaranteed identical.

zip_inspection.scope: Temporary inspection ZIP only, not an approved submission artifact

coverage: spawn shared budget and valid sites
TELE start ownership and one-command/five-unit capacity
actual first and later turns through persistent official SubprocessBot
runtime_limitations: Focused source binary checks, not GCC12.2 server ZIP runtime verification.
384MiB address-space limit is not a measured peak RSS or full server cgroup/proc isolation.
One easy SDK smoke map and tactical observations do not establish match strength or worst-case time.

confirmed_findings.description: New F production demands a second turn for every enemy-owned target, excluding a final-turn neutralization that wins.

confirmed_findings.kind: confirmed common tactical weakness, not a demonstrated v9 regression
confirmed_findings.description: An escort reaches the target while F dies to a stationary W on its first intermediate movement cell. Endpoint arrival planning does not protect the route.
When no candidate is escorted, the planner still chooses one and can send F into visible stationary W without enough support.
confirmed_findings.result_scope: Already losing fixture; no claim this loss changes the winner.

source_hypotheses_not_established_as_mat: Early guard can remove a W required by the selected F route because the v8 seed escort-preservation check is absent.
One enemy F can induce simultaneous reservations for several alternative targets; each target threat is considered separately.
New terminal guard does not add hypothetical enemy production, and terminal attack risk omits newly produced or remote TELE W.
Future TELE reservations are rebuilt each turn and there is no persistent mission identity; random target changes may break staged arrivals.
LOCK refuses expansion and uses only currently-owned buildings for recapture positioning; preserving current lead is not a full minimax guarantee.
Late planner does not use cumulative occupation or remaining unit value as explicit tie-break objectives.
Broad 1..4 hidden-score bounds are safe but loose, missing location ranges and correlated mirror cancellation.
Optional report-stderr output can be large; report decision_ms excludes the later serialization/flush cost.

official_history_case.inputs: INIT then legal observed inputs TURN1..29 including hidden -1 masks
official_history_case.counterfactual: Opponent stationary only for final input action; forced original history is not a new full match
